svg.title: Long division splits the integrand into simple pieces
svg.desc: The graph of y = (x squared + 3x + 5)/(x + 1) in two branches on either side of the vertical asymptote x = -1, and the dashed line y = x + 2. The curve hugs the line far from x = -1; at x = 3 a vertical segment marks the gap between them, 3/(x + 1). Long division gives (x squared + 3x + 5)/(x + 1) = x + 2 + 3/(x + 1).

text.tspan: (x² + 3x + 5)/(x + 1) = x + 2 + 3/(x + 1): a line you can integrate plus a piece of the form k/(x + 1).
